notes: USB manufacturer MOONDROP, product string DAWN PRO2 without a space; read from PnP and hid.enumerate() on a PC without opening the device (dac-lab:devices/moondrop-dawn-pro-2.md)

advBeta's WalkPlay row 'DAWN PRO 2' (with a space, SchemeNo15) is a different route; the USB name DAWN PRO2 selects the Moondrop route (advbeta-reddit-astra@39c16e3:android/core/src/main/kotlin/io/github/chronosauros/contour/core/native/MoondropCatalog.kt:56,81)
the vendor tool MOONDROP Hub (WebHID) matches by pid: default vendorId 13784 = 0x35D8, productId 285 = 0x011D (scope-moondrop.md:50)

audio interface MI_01; HID interface 0, usage page 0x0C usage 0x01 (Consumer Control); one 92-byte descriptor collection; reports 0x03 Input 2 B, 0x4B Input and Output 64 B with id (vendor page 0xFF01), 0x54 Input and Output 64 B; read-only, nothing sent (run:2026-10-21-moondrop-dawn-pro-2-01)

the vendor tuning config is switched on and off by holding both volume buttons for 2 s (LED orange on, red off) and is off by default after every replug (product page); whether register 0x0F carries that state is not known (scope-moondrop.md:53-55,67)
frame after report id 0x4B: OP CMD LEN payload; OP read 0x80, write 0x01; values Q8.8 int16 little-endian; band biquads computed at 96 kHz (scope-moondrop.md:34-40)
never send 01 05 01 04 (flash clear) or 01 FF (firmware upgrade) (scope-moondrop.md:130)

reset.src: MDHUB clearFlash (01 05 01 04) has no caller in the main bundle or the page chunk and the English locale has no reset string; not on the product page (scope-moondrop.md:68,91-95)

hwVolume.src: buttons only: the vendor tool has no deviceVolume feature for this model, 100 hardware steps on the product page; Windows UAC volume works but no vendor software uses it; owner question 2 (scope-moondrop.md:66,97-102,200-201)

bands.source: https://moondroplab.com/en/products/dawn-pro-2: 8 sliders in the app and web screenshots
bands.vendorApp: MDHUB index-CIZ2xpvU.js class config peqCount:8 (read from code, not seen in the UI)
bands.pcBench: run:2026-10-21-moondrop-dawn-pro-2-01 read only: 8 bands read, two reads of the same state; fixed band count not tested

types.PEAK.vendorApp: MDHUB filter code table PEAKING 2; class defaults gain -18..+12 step 0.1, Q 0.1-10 step 0.01 (code, not the UI)
types.PEAK.pcBench: run:2026-10-21-moondrop-dawn-pro-2-01 read: 8 PK bands (code 2), 20-20000 Hz, gain 0 / -3 / -5 dB, Q 0.707-2.0, inside the MDHUB limits; edges not tested
types.PEAK.acoustic: run:2026-10-25-moondrop-dawn-pro-2-08-mac-eqtest-48k (DacLab eqtest, jar 0a99e04, stream and DSP 48 kHz): PK 100 Hz Q0.7 +5, PK 1000 Hz Q2 -6, PK 6000 Hz Q5 +5 PASS, max 0.082 dB, RMS 0.016 dB; read back, then replayed as a proven log (core test resources bench/proven/dawn-pro-2/eq-pk.log)

types.LOW_SHELF.vendorApp: MDHUB LOW_SHELF_2 code 1, supportFilter true, nothing disabled (code); product page shows 'Filter Type' on Android only
types.LOW_SHELF.pcBench: run:2026-10-21-moondrop-dawn-pro-2-01 read: all 8 bands were code 2, shelves not seen
types.LOW_SHELF.acoustic: run:2026-10-25-moondrop-dawn-pro-2-08-mac-eqtest-48k: LS 100 Hz Q0.71 +5 with HS 8000 Hz Q1 -6 PASS, max 0.044 dB, RMS 0.013 dB; shelf law reg (the register plays Q / sqrt2; the q law fails one shelf case by 1.13 dB, the slope law s also fits within the tolerance), found from the registers read back; peq.shelfQScale = sqrt2 applies it (the shelf register is the intended Q times sqrt2); offered since 1.6 behind MoondropCatalog.SHELVES_VERIFIED

types.HIGH_SHELF.pcBench: run:2026-10-21-moondrop-dawn-pro-2-01 read: all 8 bands were code 2, shelves not seen
types.HIGH_SHELF.acoustic: run:2026-10-25-moondrop-dawn-pro-2-08-mac-eqtest-48k: HS 8000 Hz Q1 -6 PASS together with LS 100 Hz Q0.71 +5 (max 0.044 dB, RMS 0.013 dB), shelf law reg (see LOW_SHELF); offered since 1.6 behind MoondropCatalog.SHELVES_VERIFIED

types.pass.vendorApp: MDHUB code knows LOW_PASS_2 4 and HIGH_PASS_2 5 and flags them as pass filters in the editor; BP, AP, notch have no code mapping (code)
types.pass.acoustic: run:2026-10-25-moondrop-dawn-pro-2-08-mac-eqtest-48k: LP 8000 Hz Q0.71 PASS (max 0.128 dB, RMS 0.025 dB) and HP 100 Hz Q0.71 PASS (max 0.081 dB, RMS 0.018 dB), DSP rate 48 kHz (a 96 kHz DSP fails the LP by 10.8 dB); offered since 1.6 behind MoondropCatalog.PASS_FILTERS_VERIFIED; BP and AP have no code

preamp.source: devicePEQ: no device preamp, manual global gain
preamp.vendorApp: MDHUB supportPreGain (PRE_GAIN 0x23, -128..0, step 0.1) and supportGlobalGain (DAC_OFFSET 0x03, -18..0, step 0.1) (code)
preamp.pcBench: run:2026-10-21-moondrop-dawn-pro-2-01 read: register 0x03 = 0.0 dB (raw Q8 0); tool status UNKNOWN_EFFECTIVE, not proof of an effective preamp

write.vendorApp: MDHUB writeSinglePEQ, enableAllPEQ, setPreGain, setGlobalGain, saveToFlash = 01 01 00 only (code; the vendor sequence is scope-moondrop.md:86-88). Captured 2026-10-24 (MOONDROP Hub Beta 1.6.5, Write Cfg with a flat EQ, run:2026-10-24-moondrop-dawn-pro-2-04-mac mdhub-capture-2-write-cfg-flat.json): 01 0F 01 07, eight band frames tagged 07, 01 0A 04 00 00 FF FF, 01 23 02 00 00, 01 03 02 00 00, 01 01 00, frames 30-65 ms apart; the Hub does not check the EQ index
write.pcBench: run:2026-10-24-moondrop-dawn-pro-2-05-mac and -06-mac: after the Hub's Write Cfg the unit was still on index 9 (01 0F 01 07 ignored) and the bands of bank 9 held the written flat bands, also after replugging. Contour 1.6 writes this sequence and verifies by reading the eight bands back, whatever index the unit reports (core/native/MoondropSession.kt write)
write.persistence: run:2026-10-24-moondrop-dawn-pro-2-06-mac: the written bands of bank 9 survived a replug (the Hub's write)

output.impedance.pcBench: run:2026-10-20-moondrop-dawn-pro-2-04 3.5 mm: 0.219 Ohm +/- 0.02 at 1 kHz -3 dBFS; cross-check run:2026-10-20-moondrop-dawn-pro-2-08 0.224 Ohm

slots.writableIndexes.7.source: MOONDROP Hub: the PEQ index of the vendor catalog; the first frame of its Write Cfg is 01 0F 01 07 (capture 2026-10-24, run:2026-10-24-moondrop-dawn-pro-2-04-mac mdhub-capture-2-write-cfg-flat.json); FreeDSP-Studio dsp2.rs write_bank switches to slot 7

slots.writableIndexes.9.source: The owner's unit (firmware 1.5, USB 35D8:011D) ignores 01 0F 01 07 and stays on index 9
slots.writableIndexes.9.pcBench: run:2026-10-24-moondrop-dawn-pro-2-05-mac and -06-mac: the Hub's Write Cfg on the unit on index 9 landed in the active bank 9 (still index 9, the bands of bank 9 equal the written flat bands) and survived a replug; the sequence tagged its bands 07, the unit read them back as bank 9

peq.shelfQScale: core/native/MoondropCodec.kt (bandWrite: the shelf register Q is the intended Q times this)
